statements.notes:
Protect your collagen feel better, stay active
BeActive Collagen Shield helps support healthy collagen, joints and muscles. It contains a clinically-studied isolate from Green-Lipped Mussels that can reduce the activity of MMPs (Matrix Metalloproteases). MMPs are enzymes in your body that can damage your collagen, cartilage and other protein as you age.

How to use
Take 1 capsule, twice daily, with food. Experience best results after 6 weeks of daily use.
Caution Keep out of the reach of children.
